scores.evidence: The lesson uses です・ます throughout. There are no pressure phrases, and lessons:lint --strict reports 0 errors and 0 warnings. The round-1 stiff spots are fixed: the s3-table header is now 「役割と、付けないとどうなるか」, the section 5 title is 「依頼文を4点で点検する」, and q1 a feedback now matches s1-table with 「設定しなければ」. Hook, feedback and practice text read warmly and naturally. A few terse table cells keep the score from 4. 「依存パッケージを入れ直す」 (s1-table) reads like a feature, not a caution. 「付けないと、モードは設定しだい」 (s3-table) is clipped. s4-prompt mixes the plain form 「返すこと」 into a です・ます prompt.

measure.mjs: prose 1583 (budget 1,200–2,400), read 2654, practice reading 1232, questions 11, practice sections 2, est 20.0 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 20). Everything is within budget, though est is at the cap. Lint reports no sentence-length or paragraph-length findings. Every section has a heading and a table, code block, list or check. Inline checks follow sections 1, 2, 3 and 5, and section 4 (unattended-where) is a short definitions + table screen.

The prerequisites are stated and earlier lessons are recalled (第2回, 第7回, 第8回). Both round-1 must-fix items are fixed. s1-cost now has 「トークン（token、AIが文章を扱う単位）」 and s3-pitfall has 「シェル（shell、コマンドを実行するプログラム）」. Glossary terms match the text and the table labels (ワークツリー, バックグラウンド実行, 定期タスク, 無人実行). 分類器 was defined in cc-02. One abbreviation still comes before its definition: objective o2 uses CI before s3-lead spells it out as 「CI（Continuous Integration）」. No earlier lesson (cc-01 to cc-08) spells it out (grep). That fix is in mustFix.

The one declared locale (jp) is complete. Lint reports no locale-plain-string findings. The only link names where it goes: 「公式ドキュメント（非対話的実行）」 (s3-mode). The lesson has no images and no diagrams with embedded text. Plain-text fields (checklist labels, var hints, askTutor suggestions) contain no markdown.

mustFix.issue: (d) §2 abbreviations are spelled out on first use. Objective o2 shows CI to the learner before s3-lead spells it out as 「CI（Continuous Integration）」. No earlier course lesson (cc-01 to cc-08) spells it out. Round 1 listed this as niceToHave. It is an explicit style-guide rule (line 28: 「略語は初出で正式名を書きます」), so it is upgraded here.
mustFix.fix: objectives o2: 「CIなどで使う安全な claude -p コマンドを書ける」→「CI（Continuous Integration）などで使う安全な claude -p コマンドを書ける」

niceToHave: s2-steps ex-merge: factual doubt: 「消すと、ブランチごと消えます。」 is still not covered by the facts file. It only says 'A worktree with changes prompts you to keep or remove it'. Confirm against the worktrees page that removing a worktree on exit also deletes its branch, or soften it — 「消すと、ブランチごと消えます。」→「消すと、作業コピーがなくなります。」
s1-table: the ワークツリー cell reads like a feature, not a caution — 「別々の変更を同時に進める。依存パッケージを入れ直す」→「別々の変更を同時に進める。依存パッケージの入れ直しが要る」
s1-table: the header 「方法（まとめる人）」 does not say what is being gathered — 「方法（まとめる人）」→「方法（結果をまとめる人）」
s3-table: the dontAsk cell is clipped — 「付けないと、モードは設定しだい」→「付けないと、モードは設定や既定で決まる」
s4-prompt: the prompt mixes the plain form 「返すこと」 into です・ます sentences — 「成功の条件：{"todos": [...], "unreadable": [...]} の形のJSONを返すこと。」→「成功の条件：{"todos": [...], "unreadable": [...]} の形のJSONを返してください。」

p1-checklist pc-bare: the condition for removing --bare (no API key) is left out, so 「外すのは練習用フォルダーだけ」 reads as a general rule — 「--bare を付けています（外すのは練習用フォルダーだけです）」→「--bare を付けています（APIキーがなくて外すのは、練習用フォルダーだけです）」

check-quiz e5: option b is shorter than a, c and d, which share one frame. It is still parallel enough — 「「更新できるパッケージを調べて、いい感じにまとめて。編集はしない。調べられなければ理由を返して」」→「「更新できるパッケージを調べて、いい感じにまとめて。なければそう書いて。編集はしない。調べられなければ理由を返して」」
summary: I did a full review. review-scope.mjs exited 1: 27 of 42 blocks (64%) and 33 of 82 parts had changed. Both round-1 must-fix items are fixed: トークン（token、…） in s1-cost and シェル（shell、…） in s3-pitfall. Most round-1 niceToHave items were applied too (s3-table header, section 5 title, s4-table caption, 「設定しなければ」 in q1, <依頼文> in s3-lead and the glossary, the API-key reason in p-run). lessons:lint --strict is clean. measure.mjs gives prose 1583 and est 20.0 min, at the cap, so no fix should add length. One must-fix remains: objective o2 uses CI before it is spelled out (style guide §2). Round 1 rated this niceToHave; it is upgraded because the rule is explicit. Once it is applied, the scores (3/4/3/4, mean 3.5) pass the bar.
